scope: revision_01b: terminal-certificate semantic repair, current-manuscript hash-bound audit, Figure 1 visual provenance repair, isolated compilation, and targeted visual PDF inspection; baseline/, remote_snapshot/, and artifacts/checkpoints/pre_revision_01 were not modified

official_style_parity.basis: parent-agent verified the supplied style files against the official ICLR 2027 style zip

frozen_artifact_numeric_claim_check.interpretation: Read-only assertion check over the frozen prior source and supplied artifacts. It does not audit the current manuscript, rerun science, prove the theorem, audit citations, or establish ordered-online behavior.

current_manuscript_claim_audit.target: current manuscript paper.tex, two edited appendices, checker, and claim-evidence map
current_manuscript_claim_audit.checks: hash freshness; source differs from frozen remote source; c_H(x_N,N)=0; full-N binary pass-count rather than delivered-answer boundary; theorem/proof/DP terminal consistency; obsolete forced-stop wording absent; C04 negative-evidence wording/status; Figure 1 caption/AI disclosure; visual provenance/PNG binding; frozen result-hash and quantitative-label cross-check; verbatim Figure 1 generator/edit-history cross-check
current_manuscript_claim_audit.interpretation: A static, hash-bound audit of this exact revised snapshot. It cannot validate numerical result provenance, theorem correctness beyond the checked terminal semantic, external citations, or online deployment claims.

implementation_terminal_preflight.method: Verified the implementation's k<N loop, explicit terminal branch, and terminal comparison; enumerated the feasible without-replacement state transition support for every K in 0..8.
implementation_terminal_preflight.result: pass: every terminal reachable state has x_N=K for all 9 true-count values; terminal comparison therefore adds zero binary pass-count replay flip.
implementation_terminal_preflight.interpretation: CPU/static semantic preflight only; it does not read carrier rows, rerun a supplied experiment, or modify the frozen implementation.

visual_asset_provenance_audit.result: pass with mixed-role disclosure: current PNG is byte-identical to the frozen selected image; generator/edit history, source hashes, and rounded panel-(c) labels are recorded and cross-checked against frozen result artifacts.
visual_asset_provenance_audit.interpretation: The image generation supplied conceptual composition, not scientific measurements. Quantitative labels are evidence-linked summaries and do not independently establish replay, correctness, cost, or online-order claims.

isolated_build.command: from manuscript/: pdflatex -interaction=batchmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=../build/revision_01b_isolated paper.tex; bibtex from isolated directory with BIBINPUTS/BSTINPUTS=manuscript; pdflatex twice; copy resulting PDF to manuscript/paper.pdf
isolated_build.warnings: Final log has no undefined citations/references or TeX errors. Non-fatal underfull boxes, float-placement notices, and pre-existing hyperref PDF-string notices remain.
isolated_build.main_text_page_check: Pass: numbered main sections through Conclusion end on page 9. The recommended reproducibility statement and mandatory AI-use statement appear at the top of page 10, immediately followed by references. Both statements are excluded from the ICLR main-text count by the official Author Guidelines.
isolated_build.anonymization_check: PDF metadata Title/Author/Creator/Producer are blank; displayed author is Anonymous authors. A broader anonymization audit remains a submission gate.

visual_inspection.method: The revision author first inspected changed pages at 144 dpi. The parent auditor then rendered and visually inspected all 19 final PDF pages, including Figure 1, the nine-page main text, statements/references, proofs, DP, drift tables, Figure 2, and evidence matrix.
visual_inspection.result: No clipped text, overlap, unreadable equation, blank reference placeholder, visible hyperlink box, or other blocking layout defect observed on any page.
